svg.text: The Four Warp Shuffles, All 32 Lanes
each line runs from the lane a value is READ FROM down to the lane that receives it · loops continuously

g.text: lane i swaps with lane i^4

svg.text: A shuffle is register-to-register inside one warp: no shared memory, no barrier, one SHFL instruction.
A lane whose source falls outside 0-31 receives its own value back — which is why the reduction loop needs no bounds check.
`m` is the lane mask. 0xFFFFFFFF asserts all 32 lanes reach the instruction; if that is not true, the result is undefined.
